Title: RSI Disc. Month: Procure Refined Beryl
Description:
CONTRACT: Purchase Order
LOCATION: N/A

TERMS*:
With the recent unveiling of their new ships, RSI wishes to increase their production capacity but ran into problems thanks to a recent empire-wide supply-chain issue. As such, they have contracted with Shubin Interstellar to fulfill a purchase order for <EM4>refined beryl</EM4>.

Using a self-provided <EM4>mining ship</EM4>, harvest the beryl and <EM4>process it a refinery center</EM4> of your choice before delivering it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>. Please note, any materials delivered in excess will not be returned.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and relieve Shubin Interstellar of accountability for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
